$comment: Operational record of every model artifact the AI Musician needs.
Weights are NEVER committed to this repository -- see third_party/MANIFEST.md rule 5.
Every sha256 below was computed from the real downloaded artifact on 2026-08-21,
not copied from an upstream README. Verify on every fetch; a mismatch is fatal.

models.name: melodyt5
models.role: Global score-to-score melody variation. Runs for both Refined and Developed.

license.$comment: Verified independently of the code licence, per third_party/MANIFEST.md. The HF model card declares license: mit.

notes: ~1.36 GB. Not baked into the container image unless benchmarking shows immutable bundling is operationally better.
Upstream's published environment is an old Python/PyTorch line. Which runtime this actually runs on is decided by the compatibility spike, not assumed. See docs/architecture/musician-runtime-adr.md.

models.name: midi-rwkv
models.role: Selective symbolic infill of nominated spans, conditioned on both sides. Runs for both Refined and Developed.

license.$comment: The weight is committed inside the MIT-licensed repository at the pinned revision, so it carries that licence.

notes: Inference runtime is upstream RWKV/rwkv.cpp, NOT the personal fork MIDI-RWKV pins. See third_party/MANIFEST.md.
MIDIMetrics is excluded: no detected licence, and it is an evaluation dependency the pipeline does not need.
